test_mp3d_eqa_dataset: test the Matterport3D EQA dataset loading and verify episode count matches expected validation set
test_dataset_splitting: test dataset splitting by verifying two halves of scenes union to the full dataset
test_mp3d_eqa_sim: test the Habitat EQA simulator by sampling random actions and checking RGB observation shape
test_mp3d_eqa_sim_correspondence: test simulator path correspondence by following shortest paths and comparing RGB means to ground truth
test_eqa_task: test the EQA task by sampling actions then submitting a correct answer and verifying accuracy metric
